results.title: New US import tariff on Nigeria
results.description: On July 24, 2026, the United States (US) government imposed a new 12.5 per cent tariff on imports from Nigeria, over the country’s alleged failure to effectively implement or enforce restrictions on imports produced with forced labour. However, Washington imposed a lesser tariff of 10 per cent on India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Mexico and the United Kingdom (UK). The new tariff comes under a restructured Section 301 framework of the US Trade Act. The new measure will affect mostly non-oil imports from Nigeria, especially agricultural products and some manufactured goods. The post New US import tariff on Nigeria appeared first on The Sun Nigeria .

results.title: Trump revives debate over California's Sable pipeline project amid pushback from Newsom, West Coast governors
results.description: US President Donald Trump renewed debate over California's Sable Pipeline project, highlighting an executive order to boost offshore oil production. The move came amid an ongoing conflict with Governor Gavin Newsom, who has vowed to oppose expanded drilling along the state's coast.
